parent_objective: implement/export M1222 action-divergent candidates into relocation-compatible terminal-boundary candidate CSV
blocked_by: M1222 candidate_scores.csv is not directly compatible with source_balanced_boundary_relocation_surface
supersedes: feeding M1222 candidate_scores.csv directly into relocation tooling
invalidates: assuming field-name compatibility between normal_success_boundary_source_miner and source_balanced_boundary_relocation_surface

public_gates: M1226 may implement/export adapter artifacts only
M1226 must not run relocation replay
M1226 must preserve actor input contract
M1226 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not weaken M1222 action thresholds
do not treat exported candidates as proof rows

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: creates relocation-compatible source-balanced candidate artifacts from M1222 action-divergent rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure/export only; no relocation proof, training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if selected candidates fail source-diversity gates
stop if required relocation fields cannot be generated
stop if export requires hidden/oracle actor inputs
fallback_plan: repair adapter schema if tests fail
route to stronger source distribution if M1222 rows fail export diversity
route to materialization run only if export passes source-budget gates
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1225 selects adapter/export before terminal-boundary relocation

admission_evidence: M1225 design selects adapter/export before relocation
M1222 all-action-threshold rows have source-diversity diagnostics that justify an export attempt
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: source-diversity summary passes or fails clearly
next relocation-run or fallback route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1226 is export infrastructure and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: candidate export preserves wrong-history action-divergent rows for later materialization
source-diversity gates prevent active-set overfit before relocation
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Outcome evidence remains blocked until a later relocation run produces source-diverse margin or success degradation.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If export source diversity fails, route to stronger source distribution rather than training or threshold weakening.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A thin adapter can export M1222 action-divergent rows into relocation-compatible candidate artifacts with sufficient source diversity for a later bounded materialization run.
success_criteria: focused tests for the adapter pass
no relocation replay, source mining, outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: exported candidates are claimed as proof rows
decision_rule: M1226 passes if it produces relocation-compatible candidate artifacts with clear source-diversity accounting and no relocation replay.
